identity.kind: automatic/manual gearbox for Toyota (exact type/model not readable)

claims.claim: automatic gearbox and manual gearbox for toyota corolla, carry, hillux,...
claims.evidence: Photos show transmission assemblies but no readable Toyota model/gearbox type (automatic vs manual) or vehicle fitment markings.

risks.risk: Wrong gearbox type (automatic vs manual) or wrong variant for the specific Corolla/HiLux/Carry engine/gear ratios.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/part number (or VIN/engine code compatibility) plus the transmission code stamped on the case.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not confirmed fitment (treated as for parts / may not bolt up).

risks.risk: Non-working or damaged internals (slipping, no engagement, bad solenoids/valve body, worn clutches/gears). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (engage P/R/D or gears) or a short bench test report; also photos of fluid condition if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Missing components (sensors, harness connectors, solenoids, cooler lines, starter/torque converter parts) or incomplete kit.
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show all included parts laid out (TC, harness, sensors, shifter linkage, cooler lines) and confirm what is included/excluded in writing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: incomplete set requiring additional parts.

risks.risk: Transmission may be for a different Toyota family (or different year) despite the seller’s general statement.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped transmission code and/or the donor vehicle details (year/engine) from which it was removed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: uncertain year/engine compatibility.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the gearbox identification plate and any stamped transmission code on the case (both sides).
Confirm in text: automatic or manual for this exact unit (and which Corolla/HiLux/Carry year/engine it fits).
Video proof of operation (engagement test) or a mechanic’s test report.
List of included parts (sensors/solenoids/harness/torque converter/cooler lines/shifter linkage) with photos of everything laid out.
response.reason: The photos show transmission assemblies, but the exact gearbox type and fitment (and whether it works) are not verifiable from the images provided, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the key identification and test proof.
